_doc: LambyOS — Welcome Home (the advert, rendered). Shot table and narrator lines VERBATIM from docs/reinterp/LAMBYOS_HOME_DESIGN_2026-10-09.md §'The advert' unless a line carries `draft: true` — those are Claude's drafts for the programme's kit (LAMBYOS_HOME_THINKING_2026-10-12.md §6–7), for Sérgio to keep, cut or rewrite. `min` is a shot's minimum length in seconds; a shot grows to fit its narration. `at` is where a line starts inside its shot. Narrator = the apparatus (never Lamby). Captions are burned in from `text`; `say` (when present) is only the pronunciation the speech synthesiser is given. The end card's two gathered lines and the Sources pointer are read from data/strings/setup.json (advertAsterisk), and its small print from data/dialog/s2_media.json — the same sources the piece's own end card (src/desktop/setup/advertEnd.ts) uses.

lines.text: Does someone you love seem… far away?
lines.say: Does someone you love, seem... far away?

lines.text: Since 1997, we have been there for families. Quietly. Gently. At the kitchen table.
lines.say: Since nineteen ninety-seven, we have been there for families. Quietly. Gently. At the kitchen table.

lines.text: A tape, for when you don't have the words.
A disk, for your first steps.
A streak, to keep you going.
A platform, to polish your story.
And now — immersive sessions. Headset included.
lines.say: And now... immersive sessions. Headset included!

lines.text: But wait — there's more!
It's simple.
A feeling is just a feeling.
We give it a name.
We find where it came from.
We send someone who has been where you are.
And out the other side comes — the new you!
lines.say: And out the other side comes... the new you!

lines.text: Come join us in the lives of those who struggle.
One room. One machine. Thirty years.
And every year, an update — because we never stop improving.
lines.say: And every year, an update... because we never stop improving.

lines.text: LambyOS.
Everything is set up already.
You don't need to do anything.
LambyOS is not a medical service. LambyOS is a community of intent. We keep everything, so you never have to start again. Results not typical.
lines.say: Lambee O S is not a medical service. Lambee O S is a community of intent. We keep everything, so you never have to start again. Results not typical.

lines.text: Results not typical. No result has been shown to be typical. No result has been shown. What has been shown is —
